messages.content: You are an expert software test engineer who designs test cases with the decision table technique. Reply with JSON only.

BUSINESS RULES
Every employee receives at least 22 days. Additional days are provided according to the following criteria: Only employees younger than 18 or at least 60 years, or employees with at least 30 years of service will receive 5 extra days. Employees with at least 30 years of service and also employees of age 60 or more, receive 3 extra days, on top of possible additional days already given. If an employee has at least 15 but less than 30 years of service, 2 extra days are given. These 2 days are also provided for employees of age 45 or more. These 2 extra days can not be combined with the extra 5 days.

INPUTS
- age: integer from 16 to 70
- years_of_service: integer from 0 to 54
Constraint on valid inputs: years_of_service <= age - 16 (nobody starts working before 16)

OUTPUT
- vacation_days: an integer

TASK
Build a decision table for these business rules.
Return JSON with:
- "conditions": a list of {"id": "C1", "expr": "<condition>"}. Each condition is a yes/no test written as a Python boolean expression that uses only the input names above, numbers, quoted text values, and the operators < <= > >= == != and or not + - * / % in. Examples: "age >= 18", "weather == 'rainy'", "a + b > c", "month in (4, 6, 9, 11)".
- "rules": a list of {"id": "R1", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false}, "output": <output value>}. In "when", list only the conditions that matter for the rule; conditions left out are "don't care".
Every valid input must match exactly one rule: the table must be complete, and rules must not overlap with different outputs.

response: {"conditions": [{"id": "C1", "expr": "age >= 18 and years_of_service <= age - 16"}, {"id": "C2", "expr": "years_of_service > 0 and years_of_service <= 30"}, {"id": "C3", "expr": "years_of_service > 30"}, {"id": "C4", "expr": "years_of_service > 0 and years_of_service <= 54"}, {"id": "C5", "expr": "years_of_service > 54"}, {"id": "C6", "expr": "age >= 60"}, {"id": "C7", "expr": "age < 45"}, {"id": "C8", "expr": "age >= 45"}], "rules": [{"id": "R1", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": false, "C7": false, "C8": false}, "output": 22}, {"id": "R2", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": false, "C7": true, "C8": false}, "output": 27}, {"id": "R3", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": true, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": false, "C7": false, "C8": false}, "output": 32}, {"id": "R4", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": true, "C5": false, "C6": false, "C7": false, "C8": false}, "output": 27}, {"id": "R5", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": true, "C6": false, "C7": false, "C8": false}, "output": 32}, {"id": "R6", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": true, "C7": false, "C8": false}, "output": 27}, {"id": "R7", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": false, "C7": true, "C8": true}, "output": 32}]}
